note: Set A captures the tube array total (2 x APSE-20 = 40 TUBES) and the lot number, and breaks the cedar siding into material, profile and nominal size correctly; Set B omits the 40-tube total entirely. Set B handles the W1/W2 marks correctly as identifiers (A misbinds 1.06/1.07 as "dimension") and gives the West Elevation scale plus both-elevation datum conditions, but it garbles several values ("feet-inches", "inches per foot" appended to values) and misbinds the Finished Floor/Grade Level datums as "height". Both sets invent a "roof/overhang" entity for the PV array and repeat the same facts several times, with B duplicating the datum elevations four times each. On balance A loses fewer facts and has fewer misread values, so it is slightly better.
remarks: Both sets invent a "roof/overhang" entity to host the PV SOLAR ARRAY; the page labels only "PV SOLAR ARRAY" with no stated mounting component. The datum datums (Solar Envelope 18'-0", Finished Floor 2'-9 1/2", Grade Level 0'-0") are shown on BOTH the South (C1) and West (A1) elevations, so single-elevation conditions in A are incomplete and B reaches the right answer only by duplicating each datum claim. Neither set picks up the sheet notes (Hardie installation reference to A-511, tube array spacing/valves note, door swing convention) or the cement fibre board siding, 1x4 T&G cedar cladding on the west elevation, powdercoated steel flatbar railing posts, or the site boundary markers.
